name: Exploratorium Schematic Drive
desc:
An archaic solid-state schematic drive, never intended for human use and incompatable with modern nanoforges. Requires particular archeo-technic expertise and web of custom-forged adaptors to access. Even so, many of the designs within this database throw errors concerning outdated FRM and missing liscencing. 

Nonetheless, the error-tolerant and reliable Explorarium technology found herein is highly prized by certain groups within the Sector, and despised by others.

name: Irregular Schematic Drive
desc:
A bizzare alteration of a historical solid-state schematic drive. This chunk of nearly indecypherable hardware requires the insight of an archotechnical genius to make use of. The novel error states induced in nanofacture equipment by the schematics within could keep even a master forge-tech awake for weeks.

However, the power this drive contains is both inarguable, and inherently dangerous.

name: #Remnant Blueprint Package
desc: An original Tri-Tachyon Master Schematic database holding the designs of their beloved AI warfleet, loaded onto a battered Tri-Pad Pro. Prior to the collapse, these things would have been purchasable from the corporation for a king's ransom, but after two AI wars the corporation itself has lost all production data on these vessels... supposedly. Reguardless, these schematics can now only be acquired from Remnant Nexi, and they must be payed for in blood and gunfire.
